reading.body:
No power capacity, building count, or IT load are published for this Meta facility in Utah County. The operator's specification page this site has read contains no figures, and available public sourcing does not confirm opening date, investment, building details, or power supply details specific to this location. Without published megawatts, it cannot be ranked among Utah's 9 facilities with disclosed capacity.

Utah hosts 21 mapped data center facilities, of which 9 have published power figures totaling 52.18 MW. This facility is attributed to Meta but does not appear in the published capacity ranking, placing it among the 12 Utah facilities without disclosed specifications. The state's total published capacity remains 52.18 MW regardless of this site's actual size.

Meta operates a multi-billion dollar owned data center program and has announced major AI infrastructure investments elsewhere, most notably a 10 billion dollar project in Louisiana powered by natural gas. Whether this Utah facility is an active, expanding, or legacy site, and what power or AI capacity it currently holds, is not established by published specifications or confirmed by available sourcing.
